caption:
What Japan Keeps

Japanese beauty is admired the world over.
Yet living between Singapore and Sydney,
I notice how rarely its finest makes the journey.

In Japan, the line is clear:
department-store beauty, and everything else.
What sets our department stores apart
is quality — and the discerning eye behind each choice.
Those exquisitely made, thoughtfully designed pieces
seldom appear beyond Japan,
and fewer still know how to wear them well.

What travels instead is what exports most easily.
It unsettles me when that alone
is taken for Japanese beauty.
So I wonder: is the Japanese makeup you know
the real thing?

To carry Japan's finest, along with the craft behind it,
and fit them to the women and the skin of each city —
this has become my mission.
And, every day, a quiet joy.
